basics.name: Anas Uddin
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary:
Hi, I'm Anas Uddin — a software engineer and MSc Data Science student at Tampere University. I'm passionate about building elegant, scalable, and meaningful digital solutions. Over the past four years, I've worked on enterprise-level projects for clients in Finland and Japan, delivering high-performing, maintainable systems using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and modern web technologies.

Beyond code, I'm deeply interested in design, aesthetics, and how technology can blend function with form — whether it's crafting clean architectures, intuitive interfaces, or visually balanced experiences. My approach to software engineering is driven by problem-solving, precision, and continuous learning — from debugging legacy systems to optimizing data-driven solutions.

I'm now expanding my expertise at the intersection of software engineering and data science, aiming to create intelligent, human-centered systems that not only work efficiently but also feel intuitively right.

work.name: DVL Denim Ltd.
work.summary: At DVL Denim Ltd., I contributed to the company's digital infrastructure by developing both hardware-based and web-based solutions. My role combined hands-on system building, network optimization, and web development to improve data accessibility and online presence.
highlights: Built a headless NAS server using Raspberry Pi, Samba, and Ubuntu Linux to enable centralized data storage and retrieval, while exploring computer networks, tools, and protocols to deliver effective networking solutions.
responsibilities: Designed and deployed a headless NAS (Network-Attached Storage) server using Raspberry Pi, Samba, and Ubuntu, enabling centralized and reliable data storage and retrieval.
Explored and implemented networking tools and protocols to enhance system connectivity and optimize internal workflows.
Developed and maintained the company's official website, ensuring consistent performance, usability, and brand alignment.
achievements: Successfully introduced a low-cost, scalable storage solution that streamlined data management and improved team collaboration.
Strengthened the company's digital presence through a functional, responsive, and easy-to-manage website.
Gained in-depth experience in network systems and server configuration, complementing my core software engineering expertise.
